spec_match.rationale: Reads real LayoutShift entries (value, hadRecentInput, sources[].previousRect/currentRect) from a PerformanceObserver and now actually captures the click-triggered shift by scheduling the mutation 700ms after input, outside the 500ms hadRecentInput window.

interactive.rationale: Trigger/reset controls work; trusted CDP click produced a real entry (value 0.000352, hadRecentInput false) and the readout populated — the previous dead-readout bug (input-attributed entries filtered, readout never populating) is fixed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede and note match the CSS-pixel framing and now explain the input-attribution delay honestly.

edge_cases.rationale: Shows both branches: counted entries (hadRecentInput false) and an honest skipped-counter for input-attributed entries; transition removed so one clean entry is produced instead of per-frame micro-shifts.

references.rationale: chromestatus link present alongside MDN LayoutShift.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Trusted CDP click at desktop 1280: countdown ran, shift fired at 700ms, entry captured with value 0.000352 / hri false / skipped=1; mobile 360 scrollWidth 360; console clean except environmental fonts request; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: cls-demo-entry-captured assert fires on a real captured entry.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Countdown ticks stay out of the live region; a visually-hidden polite region announces scheduled/fired/captured; buttons native.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 both verified clean (scrollWidth 360 / no overflow), controls reachable.

openQuestions.title: Make the demo shift visually larger
openQuestions.detail: The 8rem x 3rem box moving 2.5rem yields a tiny score (~0.0004 desktop). A larger stage/box would make entry.value legible as a meaningful CLS number while keeping the same teaching flow.

openQuestions.title: CSS-px vs device-px is asserted, not observed, at DPR 1
openQuestions.detail: On this DPR=1 environment CSS px and device px coincide, so the '145+ reports CSS pixels' claim rests on the spec text and the zoom-resilience-checker's measurement probe; re-verify on a real DPR>1 device with Chrome 145.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates aria-live countdown delayed action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Centralize announcements in a single polite live region; do not announce interstitial ticks or spam live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Visible 0.1s countdown updates a plain status element; a separate visually-hidden aria-live=polite region receives only scheduled/fired/captured messages.

summary: Fixed the shared dead-readout defect: click-triggered shifts carried hadRecentInput:true and were filtered, so the captured-entry panel never populated. The mutation is now scheduled 0.7s after the click with a visible countdown, the transition was removed for one clean entry, and input-attributed entries are surfaced honestly in a skipped counter. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
